description:
## What

Extract email-in-DN against rfc822-name-constraint check (~72 lines) from `check_name_constraints` into `pub(crate) fn check_email_in_dn_against_rfc822(...)`.

## Risk

Medium.

## has_rfc822_constraint precondition (PKIX-als9 design §3)

> "precondition guard `has_rfc822_constraint` is non-obvious and load-bearing"

If the guard does not fire, the helper iterates over DN attributes searching for emailAddress and validates against rfc822-name constraints. Mishandling the guard can cause spurious NC violations (false positive) or, worse, silent bypass (false negative). Either fail-closed by keeping the guard at the call site, or move the guard into the helper with an explicit comment.

## Acceptance

- New helper.
- has_rfc822_constraint precondition guard preserved.
- check_name_constraints under 100 lines after this lands.
- PKITS NC tests (§4.13) pass.
- clippy clean.
- No behaviour change.
title: als9: N3 — extract check_email_in_dn_against_rfc822 (~72 lines)
